four_part_rule_interpretation: The released rule is best interpreted as a conjunction, not a vote: restricted ICI and restricted log loss must both improve, while linked ICI and linked log loss must both worsen. A 3-of-4 point-sign rule would label SUPPORT2 despite its restricted ICI worsening, which is not the target-mismatch pattern being defined.
provenance_interpretation: The public repository contains a single consolidated release commit. It verifies the exact released configuration and rule, but does not independently establish when the authors first inspected linked-outcome results. No new experiment can retroactively prove that chronology; only contemporaneous dated records could.
